verses.ya-la-imi-fi-l-hawa-l-udhriyyi-ma-dhirat: yā lāʾimī fī l-hawā l-ʿudhriyyī maʿdhirata ʾinnā banī nahshali wallāhi wallāhi
yā dhā ʿtirāḍi ʿalā kilmāti jawharinā daʿi ʿtirāḍaka ʾahla llāhi llāhi
wakullu mā jāʾa min ʾahli l-fuyūḍi fakun musallimā taḥẓa khayrāti mina llāhi
walafẓu "ʾasqama" mā qad ʿudda munḥarifā mā jāʾa min ḥaḍrati t-taḥrīfi was-sāhī
wamaʿa dhā lam yakun fī l-baḥthi muqtaṣirā ʾāḥādu ʾaṣḥābinā llāhi billāhi
